HomePage.processSubtitle: From input to actionable insight in three simple steps.
HomePage.step1Desc: Automatically collect and synchronize real-time electrical metrics from your connected IoT sensors. This ensures our model runs on accurate, live data without manual entry.
HomePage.step2Desc: Our advanced CART Decision Tree model processes the incoming metrics against comprehensive historical energy patterns, instantly generating highly accurate wattage forecasts tailored to your specific hardware setup.
HomePage.step3Desc: Review the detailed wattage forecasts through our intuitive dashboard. Identify usage spikes and implement data-driven strategies to significantly optimize your daily electrical consumption.
